subject: Edgar Martinez Outstanding Designated Hitter Award
query: what is the edgar martinez award
title: What is the Edgar Martinez Award? MLB's best DH; 2026 winner Nov. 11
answer: The Edgar Martinez Outstanding Designated Hitter Award goes to MLB's best designated hitter each season. It has been given since the DH was introduced in 1973 and was renamed in 2004 for Hall of Famer Edgar Martinez, a five-time winner. The 2026 award will be presented on Wednesday, Nov. 11, at the MLB Awards on MLB Network.
body:
Orlando Cepeda of the Boston Red Sox won the first award in 1973, and none was given in 1994. David Ortiz has the most wins with eight. Shohei Ohtani won it five straight times from 2021 to 2025, matching Ortiz's five-year streak from 2003 to 2007 and Martinez's career total of five.

The 2026 winner will be revealed during the MLB Awards show in Las Vegas, which starts at 9 p.m. ET on MLB Network. The same show presents the All-MLB Teams, the Hank Aaron Awards, Comeback Player of the Year, the Rivera and Hoffman Reliever of the Year Awards and MLB Executive of the Year.
in_the_news: The 2026 Edgar Martinez Award will be announced on Nov. 11, 2026, at the MLB Awards in Las Vegas.

faq.a: In 2004, MLB renamed the Outstanding DH Award for Edgar Martinez, who won it five times with the Seattle Mariners.
